這台洗衣機中間有一根攪拌桿。

pandora.zh: 潘朵拉（希臘神話中的女子）
ai: In Greek myth, Pandora opened a jar that released troubles into the world.
在希臘神話中，潘朵拉打開了一個罐子，把災禍放進了世界。
The story of Pandora is often told to explain why bad things exist.
潘朵拉的故事常被用來解釋為什麼世上有壞事。
Bees and flowers live in symbiosis, helping each other.
蜜蜂和花朵共生共存，彼此互相幫助。
The two companies formed a symbiosis that benefited both.
兩家公司形成了對雙方都有利的共生關係。
She wore a navy pantsuit to the interview.
她穿著一套海軍藍的褲裝去面試。
A pantsuit is comfortable and looks professional.
褲裝套裝既舒適又顯得專業。
The rancher rode a brown and white pinto across the field.
牧場主人騎著一匹棕白相間的斑點馬穿過田野。
The little girl loved the pinto at the farm.
小女孩很喜歡農場裡那匹斑點馬。
She cooked pinto beans with rice for dinner.
她晚餐煮了斑豆配飯。
Pinto beans are often used in chili.
斑豆常被用來做辣豆醬。
The tattooed man at the bar had a dragon on his arm.
酒吧裡那位有刺青的男子手臂上有一條龍。
She is a tattooed artist who loves bright colors.
她是一位身上有刺青、愛用鮮豔色彩的藝術家。

tattooed.zh: 刺青（tattoo 的過去式／過去分詞）
ai: He tattooed his daughter's name on his shoulder.
他在肩膀上刺了女兒的名字。
The artist tattooed a small star on her wrist.
刺青師在她的手腕上刺了一顆小星星。
Soya milk is a popular drink for people who avoid dairy.
豆漿是不喝乳製品的人常喝的飲料。
The farmer grows soya on most of his land.
那位農夫在大部分土地上種大豆。
She sautéed chard with garlic and olive oil.
她用大蒜和橄欖油炒了甜菜葉。
The garden has rows of green chard.
花園裡種了一排排綠色的甜菜葉。
He found a matchbox in the kitchen drawer.
他在廚房抽屜裡找到一盒火柴。
The little car was no bigger than a matchbox.
那輛小車子不比火柴盒大。
He gave a nonchalant shrug and walked away.
他若無其事地聳聳肩就走開了。
She stayed nonchalant even though the test was difficult.
儘管考試很難，她還是一派輕鬆。
The gladiator fought in front of thousands of people in the arena.
那位鬥士在競技場裡於數千人面前戰鬥。
We visited the ruins where gladiators once performed.
我們參觀了鬥士們曾經表演的遺跡。
She handed him the letter wordlessly.
她默默地把信遞給他。
They sat wordlessly watching the sunset.
他們不發一語地坐著看夕陽。
Hemoglobin carries oxygen in the blood.
血紅素負責在血液中運送氧氣。
The doctor checked her hemoglobin level after the test.
醫生在檢驗後確認了她的血紅素數值。

slinky.zh: （衣服）貼身而優雅的；（動作）輕柔流暢的
ai: She wore a slinky black dress to the party.
她穿著一件貼身優雅的黑色洋裝去派對。
The cat moved with a slinky walk across the room.
那隻貓以輕柔流暢的步伐走過房間。
My little brother has eczema on his arms.
我弟弟的手臂上有濕疹。
Cold weather can make eczema worse.
天氣冷可能讓濕疹更嚴重。
She wore a clinging silk dress.
她穿著一件緊貼身形的絲質洋裝。
The toddler was tired and clinging all afternoon.
那個幼兒整個下午又累又黏人。

clinging.zh: 緊抓、緊貼（cling 的現在分詞）
ai: The koala was clinging to the tree trunk.
無尾熊緊抓著樹幹。
He kept clinging to the hope of finding his dog.
他一直抱著找到愛犬的希望不放。
The commissioned artist painted a large mural on the wall.
受委託的藝術家在牆上畫了一幅大型壁畫。
He became a commissioned officer after finishing training.
完成訓練後，他成為一名受任官階的軍官。

whitewashed.zh: 粉刷；粉飾（whitewash 的過去式／過去分詞）
ai: They whitewashed the walls of the old farmhouse.
他們把老農舍的牆壁刷成白色。
The report whitewashed the company's mistakes.
那份報告粉飾了公司的錯誤。
He drank reconstituted orange juice made from powder.
他喝了用粉末沖成的還原柳橙汁。
The reconstituted committee met for the first time on Monday.
改組後的委員會週一首次開會。

conquered.zh: 征服；克服（conquer 的過去式／過去分詞）
ai: The army conquered the city after a long siege.
軍隊在長期圍城後攻下了那座城市。
She finally conquered her fear of flying.
她終於克服了對搭飛機的恐懼。
We swam in the azure water of the bay.
我們在海灣蔚藍的海水中游泳。
The azure sky was clear on the day of the trip.
旅行那天，蔚藍的天空萬里無雲。
The painter mixed blue and white to make azure.
畫家把藍色和白色混合調出天藍色。
The walls were painted a bright azure.
牆壁漆成了明亮的天藍色。
The teacher spoke to his parents about his misbehaviour in class.
老師就他在課堂上的不良行為與他的父母談話。
Repeated misbehaviour may lead to punishment.
一再的不當行為可能會受到處罰。
The air force sent an interceptor to meet the unknown plane.
空軍派出了一架攔截機去攔下不明飛機。
The interceptor caught the ball and ran down the field.
那位攔截者抓住球並沿著球場跑去。
My uncle has some loony ideas about time travel.
我叔叔對時間旅行有些瘋狂的想法。
Everyone thought the plan was completely loony.
大家都覺得這個計畫簡直瘋了。
They drive a leased car and pay every month.
他們開的是租來的車，每個月付租金。
The company works from a leased office downtown.
公司在市區租來的辦公室裡辦公。

leased.zh: 出租；承租（lease 的過去式／過去分詞）
ai: She leased the apartment for one year.
她租了那間公寓一年。
The owner leased the land to a local farmer.
地主把土地租給當地的農夫。
The song has a long guitar intro.
這首歌有一段很長的吉他前奏。
Please give a short intro of yourself to the class.
請向全班簡短地自我介紹一下。
Only priests could enter the inner sanctum of the temple.
只有祭司能進入廟宇的內殿。
His study is his private sanctum where no one disturbs him.
他的書房是他的私人天地，沒人會去打擾。
The stylus touched the record and the music began.
唱針碰到唱片，音樂就響起了。
She used a stylus to draw on the tablet.
她用觸控筆在平板上畫圖。
The court decided to annul the contract.
法院決定宣告這份合約無效。
They asked a judge to annul their marriage.
他們請求法官宣告婚姻無效。
